body.notes:
## Summary
The meeting covered the analytics rollout and Metrika dashboards. The group decided to proceed with the rollout in the next release. Tracking-plan, dashboard, vendor-spelling, and contract-number follow-ups were identified.

## Key points
- The analytics tracking plan needs to be set up.
- Metrika dashboards are needed for the leadership review.
- The vendor spelling of “Metrika” was uncertain.
- The contract number was uncertain between “four seven two” and “four seven three.”

## Decisions
- Proceed with the Metrika rollout in the next release.

## Action items
- Chidi: Set up the tracking plan by Friday.
- Amina: Share a draft of the dashboards on Wednesday of next week.
- Amina: Check the vendor site for the spelling.
- Chidi: Ask finance tomorrow to confirm the contract number.

## Open questions
- What is the correct spelling of the vendor name?
- What is the correct contract number?

## Please check
- Dan said, “I have only heard it said out loud, so I am not sure about the spelling.”
- Dan said the contract number was “something like four seven two or four seven three.”

body.transcript:
[Dan]: Morning all. Agenda: the analytics rollout, and the Metrika dashboards.
[Chidi]: For analytics I will set up the tracking plan by Friday.
[Dan]: Great. We also need the Metrika dashboards for the leadership review. Amina, can you take those?
[Amina]: Yes, I can do the dashboards. I'll share a draft on Wednesday of next week.
[Chidi]: Is it Metrika with a k or a c? I thought the vendor spells it differently.
[Dan]: I have only heard it said out loud, so I am not sure about the spelling. Can someone check?
[Amina]: I'll look at the vendor site.
[Dan]: Also the contract number was something like four seven two or four seven three. Somebody needs to confirm that with finance.
[Chidi]: I will ask finance tomorrow.
[Dan]: Good. Decision: we go ahead with the Metrika rollout in the next release.
[Amina]: Agreed.
